description: Land Aquisition - Kings Street Matale D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically providing notices about compensation amounts being credited to the District Court for various land parcels. It includes detailed land descriptions, plot numbers, assessments, locations, and compensation details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
